# The Advent of Zero, Subject, and Integral Logic — Transverse Thread

This path follows the historical emergence of the relation QL makes explicit. The theorem remains the derivation; the history carries the mathematical, psychological, Gebserian, and technical movements in their own registers while showing their shared sequence: `0` enters the modern order of signs, falls into the externalising logic of the mental-rational, and returns as `0/1` through an integral grammar of context, relation, and recognition.

1. [[05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity|§0/1 · #4 — Gebserian Diaphaneity]] plants the historical frame: perspective produces an ego-world by locating the seer outside the scene, while diaphaneity makes the conditions of that seeing available as context.
2. [[13-s1-p0-sign-migrates|§1 · #0 — A Sign Migrates Between Worlds]] gives absence its material itinerary: placeholder, numeral, operator, origin, empty set, and meta-sign remain distinct historical offices.
3. [[14-s1-p1-sunya-operational|§1 · #1 — Śūnya Becomes Operational]] establishes the Indian mathematical hinge: zero enters arithmetic without becoming another positive magnitude.
4. [[17-s1-p4-zero-outside-math|§1 · #4 — Zero Keeps One Foot Outside Mathematics]] makes the return-edge exact: `1/0` reveals the law of its formal container.
5. [[18-s1-p5-loan-returns|§1 · #5→0 — The Loan Returns]] earns `0/1 = 1/0` in the QL relational register as the root symbolon, returning zero's formal history into the subject-pole announced at the opening.
6. [[20-s2-p1-dia-ballein|§2 · #1 — Dia-Ballein]] distinguishes parent `/ = −/−`, polar `(-1)/(+1)`, and collapsed `(-1)+/-(+1)`: the polar axis makes difference measurable; cancellation turns zero into a terminus; subtraction lets one pole appropriate the span.
7. [[25-s3-p0-eight-determinations|§3 · #0 — Eight Determinations]] carries the native QL body through `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, and `1/0`; `X/x` remains authorial before the psychological refraction arrives.
8. [[31-s4-p0-psychoid-problem|§4 · #0 — The Psychoid Problem]] and [[32-s4-p1-jung-individuation|§4 · #1 — Individuation through QL X/x]] receive the psychological history: the unconscious becomes scientifically unavoidable, while its images and formations do not exhaust its determining capacity.
9. [[35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus|§4 · #4 — Apollo Through Dionysus]] gives the integral mutation its formal payoff: the `180°` perspectival triangle opens into the `360°` contextual field, retaining the mental-rational achievement inside a higher diaphanous relation.
10. [[44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness|§5→0 · #1 — QL, MEF, Bimba, and Harness]] and [[48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return|§5→0 · #5→0 — AHI and Planetary Return]] make the advent contemporary. Technical systems externalise the contextual conditions of intelligence; QL gives human and machine work a grammar of return without installing a technical system as the owner of its own ground.

[[symbolon/episteme/maps/mono-poly-two-ones|Mono–Poly and the Two Ones — Transverse Thread]] gives the ontological kernel. This path gives the historical morphology through which the kernel becomes explicit. [[symbolon/episteme/maps/trust-faith-formal-limit|Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit — Transverse Thread]] gives the lived relation at the point where the formal return meets a finite being's need to continue.
